                Model = [string]$disk.Model; Serial = [string]$disk.SerialNumber; MediaType = [string]$disk.MediaType
                BusType = [string]$disk.InterfaceType; SizeGB = [Math]::Round([double]$disk.Size / 1GB, 0)
                Health = [string]$disk.Status; Operational = [string]$disk.Status
                Temperature = $null; Wear = $null; PowerOnHours = $null; ReadErrors = $null; WriteErrors = $null
            }
        }
    }
    return @($items)
}

function Get-BatteryDetails {
    $battery = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($battery.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
    $designed = $null
    $full = $null
    try {
        $designed = @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/WMI -ClassName BatteryStaticData -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).DesignedCapacity
        $full = @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/WMI -ClassName BatteryFullChargedCapacity -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).FullChargedCapacity
    } catch { }
    $health = $null
    if ($designed -and $full -and [double]$designed -gt 0) { $health = [Math]::Round(([double]$full / [double]$designed) * 100, 0) }
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Charge = $battery[0].EstimatedChargeRemaining
        Status = $battery[0].Status
        DesignedCapacity = $designed
        FullChargeCapacity = $full
        HealthPercent = $health
    }
}

function Get-KeyDrivers {
    $wanted = @('DISPLAY','NET','MEDIA','BLUETOOTH','CAMERA','IMAGE')
    return @(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPSignedDriver -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $wanted -contains ([string]$_.DeviceClass).ToUpperInvariant() } |
        Sort-Object DeviceClass, DeviceName |
        Select-Object DeviceName, DeviceClass, Manufacturer, DriverVersion, DriverDate, InfName, IsSigned)
}

function Get-ComponentChecks {
    $devices = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    $wifi = @($devices | Where-Object { $_.PNPClass -eq 'Net' -and $_.Name -match '(?i)wi-?fi|wireless|802\.11' })
    $bluetooth = @($devices | Where-Object { $_.PNPClass -eq 'Bluetooth' })
    $audio = @($devices | Where-Object { $_.PNPClass -in @('AudioEndpoint','MEDIA') -and $_.Status -eq 'OK' })
    $camera = @($devices | Where-Object { $_.PNPClass -in @('Camera','Image') -and $_.Status -eq 'OK' })
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Wifi = if ($wifi.Count) { 'Detecte' } else { 'Non detecte' }
        Bluetooth = if ($bluetooth.Count) { 'Detecte' } else { 'Non detecte' }
        Audio = if ($audio.Count) { 'Detecte' } else { 'Non detecte' }
        Camera = if ($camera.Count) { 'Detectee' } else { 'Non detectee' }
    }
}

function Get-HardwareSnapshot {
    Write-Log 'Analyse du materiel en cours...'
    $computer = Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem
    $bios = Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS
    $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
    $cpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -First 1
    $gpus = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
    $disks = Get-StorageDetails
    $battery = Get-BatteryDetails
    $drivers = Get-KeyDrivers
    $components = Get-ComponentChecks
    $errors = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object { $_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne 0 } |
        Select-Object Name, PNPDeviceID, ConfigManagerErrorCode)
    $internet = Test-Internet
    $activation = Get-ActivationState
    $buildNumber = [int]$os.BuildNumber
    $architecture = Get-AppArchitecture

    $ramGb = [Math]::Round([double]$computer.TotalPhysicalMemory / 1GB, 1)
    $snapshot = [pscustomobject]@{
        Date = Get-Date
        ComputerName = $env:COMPUTERNAME
        Manufacturer = [string]$computer.Manufacturer
        Model = [string]$computer.Model
        Serial = [string]$bios.SerialNumber
        CPU = [string]$cpu.Name
        RAMGB = $ramGb
        GPU = ($gpus -join ', ')
        Windows = "{0} - build {1} - {2}" -f $os.Caption, $os.BuildNumber, $os.OSArchitecture
        WindowsBuild = $buildNumber
        WindowsSupport = Get-WindowsSupport $buildNumber
        AppArchitecture = $architecture
        Activation = $activation
        Internet = $internet
        Disks = $disks
        Battery = $battery
        Drivers = $drivers
        Components = $components
        DeviceErrors = $errors
    }
    return $snapshot
}

function Update-HardwareUi($info) {
    $script:PcText.Text = "{0} {1} | S/N: {2}" -f $info.Manufacturer, $info.Model, $info.Serial
    $script:CpuText.Text = $info.CPU
    $script:RamText.Text = "{0} Go" -f $info.RAMGB
    $script:GpuText.Text = if ($info.GPU) { $info.GPU } else { 'Non detectee' }
    $script:WindowsText.Text = "{0} | {1} | Activation: {2}" -f $info.Windows, $info.WindowsSupport, $info.Activation
    $script:InternetText.Text = if ($info.Internet) { 'Connecte' } else { 'Non connecte' }
    $script:InternetText.Foreground = if ($info.Internet) { '#34D399' } else { '#FB7185' }
}

$pdfPackageId = if ((Get-AppArchitecture) -eq 'x86') { 'Adobe.Acrobat.Reader.32-bit' } else { 'Adobe.Acrobat.Reader.64-bit' }
$appMap = [ordered]@{
    Chrome = @{ Check = $ChromeCheck; Id = 'Google.Chrome'; Name = 'Google Chrome'; Registry = 'Google Chrome' }
    Firefox = @{ Check = $FirefoxCheck; Id = 'Mozilla.Firefox'; Name = 'Mozilla Firefox'; Registry = 'Mozilla Firefox' }
    SevenZip = @{ Check = $SevenZipCheck; Id = '7zip.7zip'; Name = '7-Zip'; Registry = '7-Zip' }
    VLC = @{ Check = $VlcCheck; Id = 'VideoLAN.VLC'; Name = 'VLC'; Registry = 'VLC media player' }
    PDF = @{ Check = $PdfCheck; Id = $pdfPackageId; Name = 'Adobe Reader'; Registry = 'Adobe Acrobat' }
    LibreOffice = @{ Check = $LibreOfficeCheck; Id = 'TheDocumentFoundation.LibreOffice'; Name = 'LibreOffice'; Registry = 'LibreOffice' }
    Zoom = @{ Check = $ZoomCheck; Id = 'Zoom.Zoom'; Name = 'Zoom'; Registry = 'Zoom Workplace' }
    Discord = @{ Check = $DiscordCheck; Id = 'Discord.Discord'; Name = 'Discord'; Registry = 'Discord' }
    Steam = @{ Check = $SteamCheck; Id = 'Valve.Steam'; Name = 'Steam'; Registry = 'Steam' }
    Epic = @{ Check = $EpicCheck; Id = 'EpicGames.EpicGamesLauncher'; Name = 'Epic Games Launcher'; Registry = 'Epic Games Launcher' }
    EA = @{ Check = $EaCheck; Id = 'ElectronicArts.EADesktop'; Name = 'EA App'; Registry = 'EA app' }
    Ubisoft = @{ Check = $UbisoftCheck; Id = 'Ubisoft.Connect'; Name = 'Ubisoft Connect'; Registry = 'Ubisoft Connect' }
    BattleNet = @{ Check = $BattleNetCheck; Id = 'Blizzard.BattleNet'; Name = 'Battle.net'; Registry = 'Battle.net' }
    GOG = @{ Check = $GogCheck; Id = 'GOG.Galaxy'; Name = 'GOG Galaxy'; Registry = 'GOG GALAXY' }
    OBS = @{ Check = $ObsCheck; Id = 'OBSProject.OBSStudio'; Name = 'OBS Studio'; Registry = 'OBS Studio' }
    VCX64 = @{ Check = $VcX64Check; Id = 'Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64'; Name = 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64'; Registry = 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64)' }
    VCX86 = @{ Check = $VcX86Check; Id = 'Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x86'; Name = 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x86'; Registry = 'Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x86)' }
    DirectX = @{ Check = $DirectXCheck; Id = 'Microsoft.DirectX'; Name = 'Microsoft DirectX Runtime'; Registry = 'DirectX' }
}

function Set-Profile([string]$Profile) {
    foreach ($app in $appMap.Values) { $app.Check.IsChecked = $false }
    $keys = switch ($Profile) {
        'Essentiel' { @('Chrome','SevenZip','VLC','PDF') }
        'Bureautique' { @('Chrome','SevenZip','VLC','PDF','LibreOffice','Zoom') }
        'Etudiant' { @('Chrome','Firefox','SevenZip','VLC','PDF','LibreOffice','Zoom') }
        'Gaming' { @('Chrome','SevenZip','VLC','Discord','Steam','Epic','EA','Ubisoft','BattleNet','GOG','OBS','VCX64','VCX86','DirectX') }
        default { @() }
    }
    foreach ($key in $keys) { $appMap[$key].Check.IsChecked = $true }
    $script:GpuHelperCheck.IsChecked = ($Profile -eq 'Gaming')
}

function Get-SelectedApps {
    $selected = @()
    foreach ($app in $appMap.Values) {
        if ($app.Check.IsChecked -eq $true) { $selected += [pscustomobject]$app }
    }
    return $selected
}

function Invoke-ProcessVisible([string]$FilePath, [string[]]$Arguments) {
    $process = Start-Process -FilePath $FilePath -ArgumentList $Arguments -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
    while (-not $process.HasExited) {
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
        Invoke-UiRefresh
        $process.Refresh()
    }
    return $process.ExitCode
}

function Get-InstalledAppVersion([string]$Pattern) {
    try {
        $paths = @(
            'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*',
            'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*',
            'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*'
        )
        $entries = @(Get-ItemProperty $paths -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
            $nameProperty = $_.PSObject.Properties['DisplayName']
